description_en: Deletes backup files of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. This operation is not available to new users. Users who were previously added to the whitelist can still use this operation
description_zh: 该接口用于删除RDS SQL Server的备份文件。新用户不支持使用该接口，此前已加白用户仍可正常使用
kebab_example: aliyun rds delete-backup-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-bp6wjk50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBackupFile

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeDBInstanceAttribute to obtain the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The backup set IDs. Only backup set IDs of individual database backup policies are supported. You can specify up to 100 backup set IDs at a time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can call DescribeBackups to obtain the backup set IDs
parameters.help_zh: 仅支持传入备份策略为单库备份的备份集ID。单次最多传入100个备份集ID，多个值之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。可调用DescribeBackups获取
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: Deletes backup files that were created before the specified point in time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 删除该时间点之前的备份文件。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: backup_time
